solution_principle: Loft approach: duplicate and transform a profile curve, then skin between copies. Good for controlled transitions. Extrude+Twist approach: extrude a single curve and apply a twist deformation. Good for helical/spiral forms. Cap Holes closes open Brep ends to make watertight solids.
